user.title: Connect to Yarukoto
user.description: Enter the address of your Yarukoto server, the same one the app uses.

pair.title: Approve Home Assistant in Yarukoto

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Yarukoto again
reauth_confirm.description: {url} no longer accepts Home Assistant's sign-in, probably because it was signed out in the app. Select **Submit** to get a new code to approve.

choose.title: Choose to-do lists
choose.description: Each one you pick becomes a to-do list in Home Assistant. You can add items to a list. A saved filter shows what it matches, and items can be ticked off and edited there, but not added, since a filter has no one list to add to. Saved filters are made in the app, under Browse.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full address, starting with http:// or https://
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Yarukoto server at that address.
error.server_too_old: This server is too old for Home Assistant. Update it to a version with households.
error.not_approved: That code hasn't been approved yet.
error.code_expired: That code expired. Here is a new one.

abort.already_configured: This server is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Yarukoto server.
